workunit: P229.8 Profile A diagnostic-driven retrieval quality improvement

changes: The legacy Library scorer now tokenizes Thai-only query text with the runtime Thai word segmenter and matches those terms against canonicalized document text; mixed-script queries preserve the existing Latin/code ranking because development observations showed Thai token contribution displaced a correct mixed query result.
Natural-language Spec N queries receive an explicit ranking boost only when N matches the numeric prefix of metadata.canonicalPath. Existing tenant and ACL filtering remains before scoring.

The local Profile A runner can execute the development split against the full pinned candidate source corpus and labels that run non-certifying; all-candidate validation and source hydration remain unchanged.
implementation.backward_compatibility: No schema, database, provider, vector profile, or consumer contract changed.

diagnosis.case_id_integrity: 560 unique candidate IDs and traces; all 503 raw comparison observations have unique IDs matching exactly the held-out split; 57 development rows were not included in the old raw release comparison.
diagnosis.source_integrity: For the 503-query raw diagnostic run, all 264 returned source identities existed in the pinned corpus; zero evidence digest/revision mismatches and zero expected-revision mismatches were found.

failure_taxonomy.evidence: 10 held-out queries labelled Thai contain no ASCII tokens; all 10 returned zero results, including 8 answerable cases. The legacy Profile A path applies JavaScript keyword scoring and has no PostgreSQL text-search configuration in this call path.

failure_taxonomy.cause: Natural-language exact identifier not ranked structurally
failure_taxonomy.evidence: 118 of 168 exact-identifier cases missed the required source within top 5 (baseline exact-ID Hit@5 0.297619). A generic natural-language query containing Spec N did not match the full canonical path field.
190 held-out semantic-paraphrase answerable cases missed required evidence within top 20; Profiles D-H provide the already implemented semantic/hybrid paths.

failure_taxonomy.cause: No-answer metric is a retrieval-support proxy
failure_taxonomy.evidence: The runner does not generate an answer; answerSupported means a required gold source was retrieved. In the 503-query diagnostic set there are 6 true no-answer cases and 222 answerable queries without a retrieved gold source, producing precision 0.026316 and recall 1.0. This is not an observed LLM abstention rate.

The legacy search path emits no citations, so citation precision is unavailable. nDCG/MRR use binary document-source identity labels because gradedRelevantEvidence is absent; no source/ID/revision label mismatch was found.

legacy_release_observation.cohort_disposition: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY: this 503-query split had already been inspected before this change and is not eligible for post-change certification.

acceptance_boundary: The Profile A development WorkUnit passes its functional regressions and paired development comparison: exact-ID Hit@5, MRR@10 and nDCG@10 improve without Recall@20, Thai/English/mixed recall or local P95 regression. This is not held-out certification. The prior 503-query set is diagnostic; a new untouched >=500 reviewed held-out cohort and real authorized Profiles B-H plus latency/cost observations are required before P229.8 can pass. Keep evidence weak and consequential consumers unmigrated.
